## Checklist

- [ ] The base is `NCCU-Schultz-Lab/ML-Spec`, branch `main` (not the frozen parent repository).
- [ ] One purpose per pull request.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for this change under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] The code runs on the example input (`python main.py examples/example_input.inp`), or tests pass once the repository has them.
- [ ] Docs (README, CONTRIBUTING) still match the code.
- [ ] No unpublished methods, data or results.
- [ ] AI-assisted commits carry a `Co-Authored-By` trailer.

## Release pull requests only

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`: `Unreleased` renamed to the version and date, comparison links updated.
- [ ] `CITATION.cff` and `.zenodo.json` updated (the paper this release supports, creators).
- [ ] README release table ready for the new version DOI.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full release checklist.
